sources.title: swagmylife.xd
sources.coverage: Archive located and its contents listed in Drive. Download returned a Google 503 error; archive artboards were not extracted. Live prototype and deck screenshots were used instead.

interpretation: Reimagined architectural miniature and app UI, not a reproduction of a running backend. Apartment, cafe and cultural pavilion represent the original housing/food/events datasets. Percentages are an illustrative portfolio only, not historical or current prices. No live recommendation or booking is claimed.
animation: 34-second deterministic sequence: preferences 0–5s; home exploration 5–10s; selected-home pin settles 10–11.1s; allocation rebalances 11–16s; food path connects 17–20.5s; leisure connects 21–24.5s; combined result from 25s; fade/reset 31–34s. Screen, markers and allocation use one state function.
verification: Two targeted tests pass: causal sequence, 100% portfolio invariant, repeatable seek/reset and finite geometry. 35 model meshes, 327,400 triangles in headless check. Production build: 97 pages, 0 errors, 0 warnings (124 existing/unused-code hints). Browser verified artwork/3D toggle, selection and budget changes, pause/resume, reset and light/dark rendering. No browser warning/error logs. Standard simple card retained.
